personality_one_liner: A cinematic, highly premium concierge and operations experience that feels like a five-star hotel, relying on deep slate, antique gold, and frosted glass.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Let the UI breathe. Minimal borders, prefer spacing and glass for separation.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar, sticky headers, bottom-sheet drag handles.
Use glass on featured concierge cards overlaid on hotel imagery.
Ensure text on glass has translucent tinted base underneath (≥75% opacity of surface) for readability.
dont's: Do not use glass on dense form inputs or body text regions.
Do not apply glass to every list row in the staff queue.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Role selection and authentication with a cinematic hotel backdrop.

states.loading: Centered brand-tinted spinner over blurred background
states.error: Glassmorphic toast error at the top

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of the luxury resort exterior. A dark vertical gradient scrim overlay (transparent at 0%, 90% surface at bottom). At the bottom 40%: The hotel wordmark in Fraunces, followed by minimal text inputs for Email/Password and a primary Antique Gold 'Login' button. Below it, a subtle role-toggle (Guest/Staff/Admin).

screens.name: Guest Chat
screens.purpose: The primary interface for guests to talk to the AI Concierge.

states.empty: Hero area with AI assistant avatar greeting the user, suggested action chips (Room Service, Valet) below.
states.error: Inline error message below failed prompt

screens.layout: Header: Glass effect with the hotel logo. Middle: Chat thread. AI bubbles are surfaceSecondary, user bubbles are brandTertiary. Bottom: Fixed composer with both text input and a prominent microphone dictation button. Live speech preview appears directly above the composer while speaking.

screens.name: Guest My Requests

states.empty: Illustration of a bellhop or 'No active requests' text with a 'New Request' CTA.

screens.layout: Large display title 'Taleplerim'. List layout. Each card shows the Request Type (Fraunces), Time, and a prominent State Machine progress tracker (Alındı -> Personel Gidiyor -> Tamamlandı) using brand primary to indicate active step.

screens.name: Department Queue

states.empty: Text 'Kuyruk boş' (Queue is empty) with a checkmark icon.

screens.layout: Strict utility layout while maintaining the dark luxe theme. Top: 'Bekleyen İşler' title and filter chips (All, Urgent). Below: List of task cards. Each card uses surfaceSecondary background. Priority dot, Room Number + Task Title. Bottom of card has two prominent actions: Accept (brandPrimary) and Reject (surfaceTertiary).

screens.name: Department Active Jobs
screens.purpose: Tasks currently assigned and in progress.

states.empty: Text 'Aktif iş yok' with calm icon.

screens.layout: List of active tasks. The card emphasizes 'Tamamla' (Complete) action. Includes details like room number, requested time, and a quick contact button (phone icon) to call the guest if needed.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.layout: Grid of high-level metric cards (Total active requests, Average response time, Department load). Followed by a list of 'Urgent / Escalated' requests. Uses a 2-column grid for metrics with space-between layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 6 Glass / Luxe personality token mapping. Use the Antique Gold brand colors to evoke a 5-star hotel feel.
For the Login screen, implement the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (transparent -> 90% surface) over the hero background image to ensure the auth form is readable.
Guest Chat must contain an integrated text/voice composer at the bottom. Implement a live speech preview or waveform while the user holds the record button.
Do NOT use any blue colors. Use the provided deep slate and antique gold hex codes.
Staff queues must follow a scannable list layout with clear visual hierarchy: Priority indicator, Room No., Task Title, and Accept/Reject buttons.
Ensure the status tracker in 'Guest My Requests' clearly maps out 'Alındı', 'Personel Gidiyor', and 'Tamamlandı'.
Use Fraunces (serif) only for large display titles and primary branding elements. Use Geist (sans-serif) for all other UI and lists to maintain high readability.
Add the prescribed haptic feedback events directly to button presses.
